title: Streamed chat completions report no token usage, so cost tracking records zero
symptoms: chunk.usage is null on every streamed chunk
Token counters stay at zero for streamed requests only
cause: Streaming responses omit usage unless stream_options.include_usage is set, and then only a final extra chunk with empty choices carries the totals. An interrupted stream never sends it.
fix: Set include_usage, read usage from the last chunk, and guard code that indexes choices[0].
affected: OpenAI Chat Completions streaming, checked October 2026
